title: Wire Settings settlement UI to real backend settlement APIs

requirements.summary: Update the Settings settlement UI and settlement hooks to call real backend methods (no placeholder fallbacks), refresh diagnostics/metrics via React Query invalidation, and show English error messages for backend failures.
acceptanceCriteria: As an authenticated admin, triggering settlement from the Settings page successfully runs the backend method and the UI updates the displayed diagnostics/metrics (via React Query invalidation) within a short time.
As a non-admin authenticated user, the admin settlement section remains blocked by the existing AdminOnly gate; no settlement action is available.
If the backend returns an error while running settlement, the UI shows an English error toast/message and does not get stuck in a loading state.

file_operations.description: Remove placeholder/"method missing" fallback behavior and use the generated backend types (import SettlementDiagnostics from frontend backend typings). Gate the query so it only attempts to fetch when the user is authenticated AND admin (use existing admin detection hook), preventing non-admin trap noise when the Settings page is rendered. Keep user-facing errors in English.

Remove placeholder/"method missing" fallback behavior and use the generated backend types (import SettlementMetrics from frontend backend typings). Ensure the query is enabled only when the user is authenticated (identity present) so the backend authenticated-user guard does not produce avoidable errors on public/unauthenticated renders (e.g., modules that appear outside admin-only areas). Keep user-facing errors in English.

Update mutation to call the real backend runSettlementNow() (remove "not yet implemented" branching). Gate the mutation so it can only be triggered when an actor is available and the caller is an admin (use existing admin detection hook). Improve onError handling to surface a clear English message for authorization traps vs unexpected failures, and ensure pending/loading state always clears.

Ensure the admin Settlement section’s trigger action uses useRunSettlementNow and reflects pending state (disable button / show running text). Confirm that, on success, the page updates diagnostics and metrics without reload (via existing React Query invalidation). Ensure any visible error messaging remains in English and that non-admin users do not see settlement controls (rely on existing AdminOnly gate plus hook gating to avoid background trap errors).
